positions.name: PallasineChecklistAsOnboardingRecord
positions.frame: what counts as the onboarding process of record, and how did it come to hold that status?
positions.why: src-1 states what the checklist requires of every new hire (accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift), and src-2 states its provenance — that it displaced the prior wiki page as the standard last quarter. Read together, both expressions describe the same artifact's claim to being the authoritative onboarding process: one names its content, the other its succession. The read holds even though nothing here settles whether the wiki page is fully retired in practice.
